comparison.objective: Perform gold lift-off and ordered IPA/DI rinsing while catching and disposing of all drips; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Cassette immersion and transfer, liquid-order control, and bimanual drip-dish tracking versus rigid precision alignment, hammer impact, fracture, withdrawal, and metal-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Use the dedicated lift-off beaker, transfer before drying, finish in the last rinse, and put waste in the bottle versus four contained fractures with no insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both require containment and bimanual coordination, but liquid process control is materially different from contact-driven notch fracture. No spec versions or exact timing thresholds are available.
